title: test: propose wipe-kit lines with approval history retained
public_pr_body:
AH supersedes the earlier KEEP chase_sends assumption with the reviewer decision: KEEP all seven settings/setup/AI tables; WIPE JNR-only chase_sends (89), then chase_pauses (90), before invoice/email/customer parents. Before capture/deletes, preserve complete chase/invoice/draft/sent records in a proposed immutable, owner-only, no-business-FK evidence archive, check exact JSON/digests, append the digest to the existing audit chain, then capture protected fingerprints. Duplicate mismatched evidence, missing history or cross-company links refuse the transaction; no FK disabled or link nulled.

Exact proposed lines, archive DDL/block placement, KEEP row and Xero/Sage/QuickBooks JNR-only disconnect predicate are in tests/WIPE-KIT-PROPOSED-LINES.md. No private IDs or data copied. Sanitized reviewed table list stores ord/action/schema names only.

3 unit tests parse the proposal against that table list and test wrong actions, ordinal collisions, unscoped wipes, parent ordering and archive invariants. Typecheck/targeted lint passed; all 6 SQL snippets parsed only. No SQL/DDL/archive/wipe run, private repo edit, deploy or merge. Assumption: safe-table preservation is the reviewer-approved way to retain approval evidence before operational rows are deleted. Actual archive permissions, chain/digest/equality, rollback and Marpet/other-company invariance still require independent disposable rehearsal.
